new_result.statement: For a literal original-coordinate definite physical pair B=[[a,c],[c,b]] and full arms u,v into arbitrary remaining original coordinates, let H=a v-c u. If H!=0, then for arbitrary independent cap-one sources and arbitrary remaining quadratic/affine curvature, ||p_Q||infinity<=2^(5/4) pi sqrt(3)||H||^(-1/2), with the same coefficient times interval length. No lower bound on det B is required. Essential boundedness is proved; continuity is not separately proved.
new_result.key_lemma: For f<=1, the arcsine maximal operator Af(c)=sup_R int_{c-R}^{c+R} f(y)/sqrt(R^2-(y-c)^2)dy obeys Af<=pi sqrt(M_c f), hence if q is a probability density capped by K, int q Af<=2 pi sqrt(3K). This yields sup_t E[(t-delta Y^2-2YL-W)_+^(-1/2)]<=2 pi sqrt(3M) uniformly for delta>0 when L has density cap M.
